**What problem would this solve?**
The use case or frustration behind the request.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see happen.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about.

**Additional context**
Anything else — mockups, related macOS behavior, links.

> Note: Namespace relies on undocumented macOS Space APIs and adds **no** network
> access or third-party dependencies. Requests that fit within those constraints are
> much easier to take on.
